summary.one_liner: A curated, opinionated link list of articles, tools, and books for startup founders and leaders of high-growth companies.
summary.what_it_does: This is an "awesome" style list of external links rather than software. It is organized into sections: Fundraising, Entrepreneurship, Product, Sales, Marketing, Management, Hiring, Finance, Books, and More links. The Fundraising section includes subsections for fundraising tools (equity dilution and economics calculators), angel directories, and startup pitch deck collections. The Books section lists titles such as The Hard Thing About Hard Things, Zero to One, The Mom Test, and Atomic Habits, each with a short description. Many entries are marked with a dollar icon to flag funding-related resources. Items are mostly articles from named founders, VCs, and companies, and the list links to related awesome lists (Awesome CTO, Awesome TPM) under "Other". The README contains no install or run steps.
use_cases: find startup fundraising guides and pitch advice
browse founder resources on hiring and management
look up equity dilution and startup economics calculators
reading list of startup and leadership books
customer interview and product-market fit reading
notable: Curated and explicitly opinionated, with short commentary on some entries
Covers the full founder lifecycle from fundraising to management and hiring
Includes a book list with brief summaries of each title
Links to sibling awesome lists for CTOs and TPMs
caveats: Link-only list; the content lives on external sites that may change or disappear
Opinionated selection, so coverage reflects the curator's choices rather than a complete survey
The README does not state a license
keywords: how to raise money for startup
